name: Sharpbeak's Feather
summary: Sharpbeak's feather carries a trace of the young gryphon sought in the Hinterlands. Gryphon Master Talonaxe hopes Thadius Grimshade's divining magic can use it to find him.

sections.title: A Gryphon's Feather
sections.body: Gryphon Master Talonaxe gives you a feather taken from the nest where Sharpbeak sleeps, to carry to Thadius Grimshade at Nethergarde Keep. The diviner left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge, though he remains Wildhammer in his heart. Talonaxe hopes the feather may help him find the young gryphon.

sections.title: A Sign of Promise
sections.body: Thadius recognizes the feather as belonging to a fine gryphon. He believes Sharpbeak is destined for great things, if he survives to adulthood without harm. With the feather in hand, he bids you listen closely as he begins to divine the gryphon's whereabouts.

faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade uses Sharpbeak's Feather as a link for divining the young gryphon's whereabouts.

faq.q: Where did the feather come from?
faq.answer: The feather was taken from the nest where the gryphon child Sharpbeak sleeps.
Thadius Grimshade is a Wildhammer diviner who left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge. He can be found in Nethergarde Keep's mage tower in the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: What does Thadius think of Sharpbeak?
faq.answer: Thadius calls Sharpbeak a fine gryphon, destined for great things if he survives to adulthood undamaged.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Sharpbeak's search touches the Wildhammer: Thadius Grimshade left Aerie Peak, yet still holds to his Wildhammer heart.
